A little about us

Your baby sets the pace.
We follow their lead.

The tiny fingers, the milk-drunk smiles, the way they fit perfectly in your arms—these days deserve to be remembered softly.

At First Click Prop Studio, every session is unhurried and baby-led. Our Indore studio is prepared with gentle wraps, thoughtfully styled props and a warm, calm environment. We use safe posing, patient handling and careful, natural editing to create photographs that feel as tender as the moment itself.

Baby-first, alwaysComfort and safety before every pose
Thoughtfully craftedProps, palettes and edits made to feel timeless
